message.content: I asked you to implement a comprehensive logging system in `multiagent_router_pro.py` following a strict technical specification. You added the `logging` module import, the `LOG_FILE = Path("router.log")` constant, and a `_setup_logging` method that creates a `"RouterLogger"` logger with `FileHandler` at `DEBUG` level using append mode and the specified format `%(asctime)s | %(levelname)-8s | %(message)s`. You modified `__init__` to call `_setup_logging` before `_check_environment`, and updated `_check_environment` to log `CRITICAL` on missing `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `INFO` on success. You added logging throughout `_load_memory`, `_load_routing_rules`, `normalize_prompt`, `route_request`, `_llm_route_request`, `call_agent`, `_execute_native_chat`, `_execute_aider`, `handle_complex_debug`, and `handle_evolution_pipeline` covering all lifecycle stages from intent normalization through agent execution and evolution pipeline, with appropriate `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR`, and `CRITICAL` levels as specified.
